blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Acoustic shadows from bone and other highly attenuating tissues obscure clinically important structures in ultrasound.
In fetal brain imaging, skull-induced artefacts disproportionately degrade the hemisphere closer to the transducer (proximal), limiting symmetric assessment of the two hemispheres.
Existing correction methods require raw scanner data, impose restrictive assumptions on tissue properties, or rely on generative models that may hallucinate anatomy.
We present RFlash , a physics-informed post-processing method that decomposes beamformed ultrasound images into explicit attenuation and scatter-intensity maps using a differentiable radiance-field formulation of image formation.
Attenuation-adaptive re-rendering then removes the dependence of the signal at each depth on the intervening tissue, equivalent to virtually advancing the transducer into the tissue.
Across 1,261 3D fetal brain volumes, 143 real 2D curvilinear abdominal scans, and 1,200 simulated 2D linear-probe liver scans, RFlash reduces shadow-related intensity differences more effectively than classical Hughes–Duck attenuation correction For a gestational-age model trained on the distal hemisphere (further from the transducer) and applied to the proximal hemisphere, prediction error decreases by 5.1 days (40%) relative to the original images.
The estimated attenuation maps also yield shadow-confidence maps that improve random-forest bone-shadow segmentation over the image alone and receive greater SHAP importance than an existing neural confidence-map baseline, suggesting greater physical consistency. RFlash requires neither hardware modification nor access to raw scanner data and supports 2D and 3D acquisitions with linear and curvilinear probes, making it widely applicable allowing clinicians to use our method on their already acquired scanners and images.
blocks.zh:
骨骼和其他高度衰减组织产生的声影模糊了超声波中临床上重要的结构.
在胎儿脑成像中,头骨引起的人工制品不成比例地使靠近转录器的半球退化,限制了对两个半球的对称性评估。
现有的校正方法需要原始扫描仪数据,对组织属性施加限制性假设,或者依赖可能产生解剖幻觉的基因模型.
我们提出了RFlash,一种物理上知情的后处理方法,利用不同辐射场的图像形成方式,将束状超声波图像分解成明显的衰减和散射强度图。
加速-适应性再还原,然后消除每个深度信号对干涉组织的依赖性,相当于几乎将转录器推进到组织中.
在1,261个3D胎儿脑体积,143个真正的2D卷曲腹部扫描,以及1,200个模拟的2D线性预测肝脏扫描中,RFlash比古典Hughes–Duck衰减修正更有效地减少与影子有关的强度差异 对于一个在Distal半球受过训练的孕期模型(离转录器更远)并应用于近缘半球,预测误差比原始图像减少5.1天(40%).
估计的衰减图还产生影子自信图,这些图单在图像上改进随机森林骨影分化,比现有的神经自信图基线更重视SHAP,表明物理上的一致性更高. RFlash既不要求硬件修改,也不要求获取原始扫描仪数据,并用线性探测器和曲面探测器支持2D和3D的获取,使其广泛适用,允许临床医生在已经获得的扫描仪和图像上使用我们的方法。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Ultrasound is a standard imaging modality in prenatal care [ 1 ] .
It is cost-effective, portable, and low risk, which makes it suitable for repeated clinical examinations.
Despite substantial improvements in image quality in recent decades, ultrasound images still suffer from low signal-to-noise ratio and physics-based artefacts, including acoustic shadows, reverberations, drop-out, and enhancement artefacts.
These artefacts reduce local contrast and can obscure structures that are clinically relevant [ 2 ] .
blocks.zh:
超声波是产前护理中的一种标准成像方式[1].
它具有成本效益、可携带性和低风险,因此适合重复进行临床检查。
尽管近几十年来图像质量大有改善,但超声波图像仍然受到信号对噪音比率低和物理工艺的影响,包括声影、反响、退出和增强工艺品。
这些工艺物降低了局部的对比度,并可能模糊临床相关的结构[2].

blocks.en:
Shadow artefacts are particularly limiting when highly attenuating structures cannot be avoided by changing the probe position.
This is common in fetal brain ultrasound, where the skull increasingly calcifies during gestation and produces stronger attenuation.
As a result, the distal (further from the transducer) hemisphere is often better visible than the proximal (closer to the transducer) hemisphere, which limits assessment of bilateral anatomy and symmetry [ 3 , 4 ] .
This is clinically relevant as brain symmetry is an important biomarker in fetal neurodevelopmental assessment [ 5 ] .
Representative examples of these artefacts are shown in Figure 1 .
Effective shadow reduction could, therefore, increase the amount of usable image information by improving visibility in the proximal hemisphere.
blocks.zh:
在无法通过改变探测器位置来避免高度衰减的结构时,影子手工艺品尤其受到限制。
这在胎儿大脑超声波中很常见,大脑颅骨在孕育期间的钙化程度越来越高,产生更强的衰减.
因此,离子(离转录器更远)半球往往比近子(离转录器更近)半球更明显,它限制了对双边解剖学和对称性的评价[3,4].
这在临床上是相关的,因为大脑对称性是胎儿神经发育评估中一个重要的生物标志[5].
这些手工艺品的代表性例子见图1。
因此,有效减少阴影可以通过提高近西半球的能见度来增加可用图像信息的数量。

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Acoustic artefacts in clinical B-mode ultrasound. Solid red boxes mark acoustic shadows behind strongly attenuating structures. The dashed blue box marks reverberation, the dashed green box marks enhancement artefacts, and the dashed orange box marks the contrast difference between the proximal (closer to the transducer) and distal (further away from the transducer) fetal brain hemispheres. RFlash targets enhancement and shadow artefacts and, to some extent, the contrast difference between the hemispheres.
blocks.zh: 图1:临床B-mode超声波中的声学文物。 固体红盒在强烈衰减结构背后标记声波阴影. 破碎的蓝盒标记反射,破碎的绿盒标记增强手工业品,破碎的橙盒标记了近缘(靠近转录器)和异缘(离转录器更远)胎脑半球的对比差. RFlash针对的是增强和影子手工艺品,以及在某种程度上,半球之间的对比性差异。

blocks.en:
Although shadow reduction is important, it remains an unsolved problem [ 2 , 6 , 7 ] .
Most ultrasound reconstruction pipelines assume similar sound-energy reduction across neighbouring scanlines. Heterogeneous tissue violates this assumption, which can lead to local under- or over-exposure [ 8 ] .
Classical shadow-reduction methods compensate for such intensity variation using restrictive statistical or physical assumptions.
For example, Hughes and Duck [9] and Knipp et al. [10] assume a linear relation between attenuation and scattering, which may break down in complex geometries and heterogeneous tissue.
Frequency-based attenuation estimation has also been explored [ 11 ] , but requires frequency information in their RF data, which almost all commercially available scanners don’t provide, limiting its use as a post-processing method.
Learning-based approaches can reduce artefacts visually, but may lack physical grounding, may generalize poorly across probes, and can introduce hallucinated image content [ 12 , 13 ] .
blocks.zh:
虽然减少阴影很重要,但它仍然是一个未解决的问题[2,6,7].
大部分超声波重建管道都假设相邻的扫描线也有类似的音能减少. 异质组织违反这一假设,可能导致局部接触不足或过度接触[8].
传统的减少阴影方法利用限制性的统计或物理假设来弥补这种强度变化。
例如,Hughes和Duck[9]和Knipp等人. [10] 假设衰减和散射之间的线性关系,这种关系可能在复杂的几何和不同的组织中破裂。
还探索了基于频率的衰减估计[11],但要求在其RF数据中提供频率信息,几乎所有商业上的扫描仪都没有提供,限制了其作为处理后方法的使用。
以学习为基础的方法可以减少手工艺品的视力,但可能缺乏物理地基,在探测器之间可能泛泛而论,并可以引入幻觉图像内容[12、13]。

blocks.en:
In this work, we introduce R adiance F ie l d for a coustic sh adow reduction ( RFlash ), a physics-informed post-processing approach that explicitly models ultrasound propagation through tissue. RFlash uses a fully differentiable ultrasound simulation pipeline to decompose ultrasound images into physically interpretable parameter maps.
These parameters are then used to render attenuation-corrected, shadow-reduced images.
Conceptually, the shadow-free rendering can be interpreted as virtually moving the transducer through the tissue, as illustrated in Figure 2 .
Each rendered depth is made less dependent on tissue closer to the original transducer position, preventing proximal structures from casting shadows onto deeper regions.
As the method operates as post-processing and uses a canonical scanline-based imaging model, it can be applied without hardware constraints and can support different acquisition geometries, including linear and curvilinear probes as well as 2D and 3D ultrasound.
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们引入了R adivance F ie l d 来进行粗糙的 sh 吸附还原(RFlash),这是一种物理上知情的后处理方法,它明确模拟超声波通过组织传播. RFlash使用完全不同的超声波模拟管道将超声波图像分解成物理解释参数地图.
然后使用这些参数来使衰减修正的,阴影的图像减少.
从概念上讲,无阴影渲染可被解释为实际上将传导器通过组织移动,如图2所示。
每个变深都较少依赖靠近原转录器位置的组织,防止近缘结构向更深的区域投影.
由于该方法作为后处理操作,并使用基于犬形扫描线的成像模型,因此可以在没有硬件限制的情况下应用,并且可以支持不同的获取几何,包括线性探测器和曲面探测器以及2D和3D超声波.

blocks.en:
We evaluate RFlash on fetal brain, real abdominal, and simulated liver ultrasound data spanning 3D acquisitions with a 3D probe, curvilinear 2D acquisitions, and simulated linear-probe data.
The method improves image quality both visually and quantitatively, producing more uniform contrast across fetal brain hemispheres and reducing shadow-related intensity differences in real images.
We further show that the recovered proximal-hemisphere information is relevant for a downstream fetal age-prediction task.
Finally, we derive shadow confidence maps directly from the attenuation parameter and show that these maps are informative for random-forest shadow segmentation and perform well compared to existing methods.
blocks.zh:
我们评估胎儿大脑上的RFlash, 真正的腹部, 模拟的肝超声波数据 跨越3D的3D获取, 曲线2D获取, 模拟的线性检测数据。
该方法在视觉和数量上都提高了图像质量,在胎儿脑半球之间产生了更一致的对比,并减少了真实图像中与阴影相关的强度差异.
我们进一步表明,所回收的近交层信息与下游胎儿年龄预测任务相关。
最后,我们直接从衰减参数中得出阴影信任图,并表明这些图为随机森林阴影分解提供了信息,与现有方法相比表现良好。

blocks.en: The code, as well as links to most of the data, can be found in the GitHub repository: https://github.com/vbacher/RFlash
blocks.zh: 该代码以及大多数数据的链接可见于GitHub仓库:https://github.com/vbacher/RFlash.

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Principle of shadow-free rendering. Left: in a conventional acquisition, the intensity at a given depth (green ray) depends on all tissue between the transducer and that depth, so attenuating structures such as the skull cast shadows into everything below them. Right: RFlash renders each depth as though the transducer had been advanced to just above it (orange arcs, short green rays), making the rendered intensity independent of overlying tissue and suppressing the shadow.
blocks.zh: 图2:无阴影渲染原理. 左:在常规获取中,特定深度(绿色射线)的强度取决于传导器与该深度之间的所有组织,因此像头骨这样的减弱结构将阴影投入其下方的一切. 对: RFlash使每个深度都好像转导器被推进到它的正上方一样(橙弧,短绿色射线),使得到的强度独立于上方组织并压制阴影.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Shadow Artefact Reduction and Detection
blocks.zh: 2.1 减少和检测阴影成像

blocks.en:
Earlier shadow reduction methods typically used single-step estimates, due to computational limitations.
These approaches often estimate attenuation statistically using maximum-likelihood estimators [ 14 ] , or derive closed-form attenuation and scatter maps. Knipp et al. [10] and Hughes and Duck [9] assume a linear relation between attenuation and scattering, which allows closed-form solutions but over simplifies tissue properties.
Related ideas have also been used more recently in optical coherence tomography, which has similar echo-based imaging principles but uses coherent light [ 15 , 16 ] .
To the best of our knowledge, these are the only shadow-reduction techniques that work as a post-processing step on B-mode images and does not require any data annotation for training and/or inference, which is why we chose Hughes shadow reduction as our baseline.
Frequency-based methods estimate attenuation from attenuation-dependent shifts in the signal centre frequency [ 11 , 17 ] and require frequency information only contained in Radio Frequency (RF) data, that most clinical systems do not provide.
blocks.zh:
由于计算限制,早先的阴影减少方法通常使用单步估计。
这些方法往往利用最大概率估计值来统计地估计衰减,或得出封闭式衰减和散射图。 Knipp等人著. [10]和Hughes和Duck [9] 假设衰减和散射之间的线性关系,这允许封闭式溶液,但优于简单化的组织特性.
相关的想法最近也被用于光学一致性成像学中,它具有类似的基于回声的成像原理,但使用一致光[15,16].
据我们所知,这是作为B-mode图像处理后步骤的唯一减少阴影技术,不需要任何数据说明来进行培训和(或)推论,这就是我们选择休斯减少阴影作为基线的原因。
基于频率的方法估计信号中心频率[11,17]中受衰减影响变化的衰减程度,要求的频率信息仅包含在无线电频率(RF)数据中,而大多数临床系统并不提供.

blocks.en:
More recent methods use iterative optimisation. Yu and Wang [18] solve a small partial differential equation in each iteration, which increases computational cost.
Machine-learning approaches often focus on shadow detection rather than shadow removal, commonly using generative adversarial networks (GANs) [ 12 , 13 ] .
These methods can produce visually plausible results, but GANs may hallucinate image content, which limits their reliability for medical use, as hallucinations may miss abnormalities affecting diagnosis.
blocks.zh:
最近的方法使用迭代优化. 余和王[18]在每个迭代中解小部分微分方程,这增加了计算成本.
机器学习方法往往侧重于影子检测而不是去除阴影,通常使用基因对抗网络[12,13].
这些方法可以产生视觉上可行的结果,但GANs可能会产生幻觉,这限制了它们对于医疗用途的可靠性,因为幻觉可能会错过影响诊断的异常.

blocks.en:
RFlash operates on B-mode images and does not require frequency information or complex solvers at each iteration.
It is trained on an individual-image basis, preventing knowledge transfer between subjects and reducing the risk of hallucinations.
blocks.zh:
RFlash在B-mode图像上运行,不需要频率信息或每个迭代的复杂解析器.
它以个人形象为基础进行培训,防止学科之间的知识转让,减少产生幻觉的风险。

blocks.en: 2.2 Radiance Fields
blocks.zh: 2.2 辐射场

blocks.en: Neural radiance fields (NeRFs) learn volumetric scene representations by mapping spatial coordinates and viewing directions to colour and opacity [ 19 ] . This implicit representation has been widely extended across domains [ 20 ] . In medical imaging, radiance fields have been used to reconstruct 3D ultrasound volumes from 2D slices [ 21 , 22 , 23 , 24 , 25 , 26 ] . Hybrid and Gaussian-splatting variants further reduce training time [ 27 , 28 , 29 ] .
blocks.zh: 神经辐射场(NERFs)通过绘制空间坐标并查看颜色和不透明方向来学习体积场景表现[19]. 这一隐含的表述已广泛扩展到各个领域[20]。 在医学成像中,利用光场从2D切片重建3D超声波卷[21,22,23,24,25,26]. Hybrid and Gaussian-splating变体进一步缩短了训练时间[27,28,29].

blocks.en: We build on this work by adapting Radiance Fields to ultrasound physics. Instead of learning visual appearance, our model learns tissue parameters with a differentiable, physics-informed renderer. Unlike conventional Radiance Fields trained from 2D projections, we use cross-sectional slice data and treat each ray as a direct observation of local acoustic interactions. For efficiency and interpretability, we use a fully explicit representation [ 30 , 31 ] , which supports fast training and transparent parameter estimates.
blocks.zh: 我们在这项工作的基础上,通过将辐射场适应超声物理学。 我们的模型不是学习视觉外观,而是学习组织参数,使用一种不同的,物理上知情的渲染器. 不同于常规的辐射场从2D预测中训练,我们使用截面切片数据,并将每个射线作为局部声学相互作用的直接观测. 为了提高效率和可解释性,我们使用一个完全明确的代表[30,31],支持快速培训和透明的参数估计。

blocks.en: To our knowledge, this is the first use of radiance fields for shadow artefact reduction in ultrasound.
blocks.zh: 据我们所知,这是首次利用光场减少超声波中的阴影动脉作用。

blocks.en: 2.3 Ultrasound Simulation
blocks.zh: 2.3 超声模拟

blocks.en: Our scene representation is learned from an ultrasound slice or volume using a differentiable ultrasound simulation. Efficient ultrasound simulators use convolutions or point-spread functions with tissue parameters or scatterers [ 32 , 33 , 34 , 35 , 36 ] , and can be implemented efficiently on GPUs [ 37 , 38 ] . These methods approximate interference patterns from point scatterers well, but do not explicitly model shadow formation along scanlines. Ray-tracing and scanline-tracing methods address this by modelling acoustic propagation at tissue interfaces [ 39 , 40 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们的场景表现是从超声波切片或体积中学习的,使用不同的超声波模拟. 高效的超声模拟器使用带有组织参数或散射器的演化或点散函数[32,33,34,35,36],并可在GPU上高效执行[37,38]. 这些方法从点散射器上对干扰规律进行了很好的近似,但并没有在扫描线上明确模拟阴影形成. 光线跟踪和扫描跟踪方法通过在组织接口建模声学传播[39,40]来解决这一问题。

blocks.en: Extensions with convolutional scattering models [ 41 , 42 ] or Monte Carlo sampling [ 43 , 44 ] improve realism, but are computationally expensive and often non-differentiable. This limits their use in learning-based optimisation. Recent differentiable ray-based models improve optimisation compatibility [ 45 ] , but still rely on restrictive sampling.
blocks.zh: 带有旋转散射模型的扩展[41,42]或蒙特卡洛取样[43,44]改进了现实主义,但计算成本昂贵,而且往往无差别. 这限制了它们在基于学习的优化中的使用。 最近不同的射线基模型提高了优化兼容性[45],但仍然依赖于限制性的采样.

blocks.en:
In this work, we use a simplified differentiable ray-based model that ignores cross-scattering effects [ 46 ] and models signal intensities directly, which is in line with other physics models used for shadow reduction and 2D to 3D reconstruction [ 9 , 22 ] .
This avoids point-spread-function convolution and enables fast, physically consistent simulation for iterative optimisation and shadow correction.
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们使用简化的异射线基模型,忽略了交叉散射效应[46],模型信号强度直接,这与其他用于减少阴影的物理模型以及2D到3D重建[9,22]是一致的.
这避免了点散函数的演化,并且能够快速,物理上一致地模拟迭代优化和阴影修正.

blocks.en: 3 Methods
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en: Analogous to most NeRF-like models [ 19 ] , our method comprises two main components: a scene representation learned as a set of physics-informed tissue parameters and a differentiable ultrasound simulation that renders those parameters into ultrasound images. Both components are used in two steps: decomposition (a), which learns the tissue parameters, and shadow-reduced rendering (b), which renders the shadow-free images, as shown in Figure 3 .
blocks.zh: 与大多数类似NERF的模型[19]类似,我们的方法包括两个主要组成部分:作为一套物理学知情组织参数而获得的场景表现和一种不同的超声波模拟,使这些参数成为超声波图像。 如图3所示,这两个构件分两步使用:分解(a),即学习组织参数,以及减少阴影的渲染(b),即使图像无阴影。

blocks.en: 3.1 Ultrasound image formation model
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 超声波图像形成模型

blocks.en:
Ultrasound scanners differ in their proprietary acquisition and processing pipelines.
Since RFlash is applied as a post-processing method to the final B-mode image, we assume that all images were generated using the standard pipeline shown in Figure 4 . The exact signal processing pipeline of the image to be shadow removed does not need to be known for RFlash to work.
blocks.zh:
超声波扫描仪在专有获取和加工管道方面各不相同.
由于RFlash作为处理后方法应用于最终的B-mode图像,我们假设所有图像都是利用图4所示的标准管道生成的. 要去除阴影的图像的确切信号处理管道不需要因为RFlash而得名.

blocks.en: Figure 4 : The canonical ultrasound imaging pipeline on which RFlash is built. Tissue response (left) is modulated by the propagating sound field, then processed in the scanner (centre: envelope detection, time-gain compensation, log compression) and converted to a display image (right: A/D conversion, binning, scan conversion). RFlash operates on the displayed, beamformed image and inverts the shaded operations. A/D conversion and binning are lossy and are not modelled. Compare with Figure 6 , which shows the corresponding differentiable pipeline for beamformed images.

blocks.en: We assume that the input data have already been beamformed at the transducer, which is the process of focusing the ultrasound beam and forming the initial image. This allows each scanline to be treated independently along the propagation direction. The measured signal is corrected by time-gain compensation (TGC), logarithmically compressed, and envelope-detected using a Hilbert transform before display. It is then scan-converted from samples along scanlines into a Cartesian image grid. For linear probes, scan conversion reduces to resampling anisotropic scanline samples onto image pixels. For curvilinear probes, polar coordinates are additionally mapped to a Cartesian grid. For 3D probes, a mapping from the scanline–depth coordinate system to Cartesian volumes for storage and display is needed, which requires some knowledge of the 3D probe type. The 3D data we used were acquired with a mechanical probe that we model as a curvilinear 2D probe rotated around an internal probe axis, producing different angular coordinates in the two lateral directions, as illustrated in Figure 5 . We do not model analogue-to-digital (A/D) conversion or binning, because the available inputs are already digitised and these lossy steps cannot be recovered from post-processed images.
blocks.zh: 我们假设输入数据已经在转录器上成束,这就是聚焦超声波束和形成初始图像的过程. 这样可以沿着传播方向独立处理每个扫描线. 测量到的信号通过计时补偿(TGC)进行校正,对数压缩,并在显示前使用希尔伯特变换器进行信封检测. 然后从扫描线的样本中将其转换成笛卡尔图像网格。 对于线性探测器,扫描转换会减少将异构扫描线样本复制到图像像素上. 对于曲线探测器,极地坐标被附加到笛卡尔网格上. 对于3D探测器,需要从扫描线–深度坐标系统映射到笛卡尔卷进行存储和显示,这需要一些对3D探测器类型的了解. 我们使用的3D数据是用一个机械探测器获得的,我们用这个探测器模拟成一个卷曲2D探测器围绕一个内部探测轴旋转,在两个横向方向产生不同的角坐标,如图5所示。 我们不建模模拟到数字(A/D)转换或binning,因为现有的输入已经数字化,这些丢失的步骤无法从处理后的图像中回收.

blocks.en: 3.2 Explicit radiance-field representation
blocks.zh: 3.2 明亮的光线场代表

blocks.en: Our model follows the radiance-field view of differentiable image formation, as summarised in Figure 3 . Unlike the original NeRF formulation [ 19 ] and recent ultrasound radiance-field methods [ 21 , 22 ] , we do not represent the scene with a multi-layer perceptron (MLP). MLPs provide a continuous representation, but are slow to optimise and less interpretable because each weight can affect the scene globally. In our setting, the input volumes have a fixed discrete resolution; therefore, an implicit continuous representation provides limited practical benefit.
blocks.zh: 如图3所示,我们的模型遵循了不同图像形成的光场视野。 与最初的NERF配方[19]和最近的超声波辐射场方法[21,22]不同,我们并不用多层感官(MLP)代表场景. MLP提供连续的表示,但由于每个重量可以影响全球的场景,因此在优化和解释上缓慢. 在我们的环境下,投入量具有固定的离散分辨率;因此,隐含的连续表示提供了有限的实际效益。

blocks.en: We instead use a fully explicit volumetric representation. This representation is straightforward to initialise, inspect, and optimise, at the cost of a larger memory footprint. During training, each pixel in a reference ultrasound image is mapped into the representation space, which has the dimensions of the padded input image. The corresponding tissue parameters, such as attenuation and scatterer density, are sampled from the explicit volume using trilinear interpolation and passed through the differentiable ultrasound simulator. The rendered 2D image is then compared with the reference image to update the volumetric parameters.
blocks.zh: 相反,我们使用完全明确的数量代表。 这种表述方式很容易公开、检查和优化,而代价是更大的记忆足迹。 在训练期间,一个参考超声波图像中的每个像素被映射到代表空间中,它具有加成输入图像的维度. 相应的组织参数,如衰减和散射器密度,利用三线插值从显性体积中取样,并通过不同的超声模拟器. 然后将渲染的2D图像与参考图像进行比较,以更新音量参数.

blocks.en: 4.1 Datasets

blocks.en: For evaluation, we used four different data sources spanning three different transducer geometries.

blocks.en:
The main dataset used is a set of 3D fetal-head ultrasound volumes acquired as part of the INTERGROWTH-21 st {}^{\textrm{st}} study [ 48 ] , one of the largest fetal head ultrasound studies.
Data were collected using a Philips HD9 (Philips Healthcare, Amsterdam, The Netherlands) scanner equipped with a curvilinear abdominal transducer (V7-3 3D).
The dataset comprised 1261 volumes from fetuses between 15 and 31 gestational weeks (GW), each standardised to a spatial resolution of 160 × 160 × 160 160\times 160\times 160 pixels.
Further details on dataset acquisition, selection criteria, and preprocessing are provided in [ 5 ] .

blocks.en: We also evaluated our method on a publicly available abdominal ultrasound dataset [ 49 ] . We used only the real scans from the test dataset, which contains 213 different 2D ultrasound scans of the liver, spleen, and kidneys. For 70 of these scans, no geometry could be determined by our geometry estimator, mostly because of coupling artefacts between the transducer and the skin. Without knowing a good estimation of the scanner geometry, we cannot accurately apply our shadow reduction method. As our method focuses on shadow reduction rather than geometry estimation, we omitted these scans.

blocks.en: 4.5 Evaluation: Age prediction as clinical downstream task
blocks.zh: 4.5 国家 评价: 将年龄预测作为临床下游任务

blocks.en: To assess the clinical relevance of the recovered structures in the proximal hemisphere, we evaluated whether a standard age-prediction model can make better use of this region after shadow reduction. Following [ 54 , 55 ] , we trained a 3D ResNet-10 [ 56 ] to predict fetal age from the better-visible distal hemisphere. The model was trained on the fetal brain volumes described in Section 4.1 , aligned to a common space and size-normalised, which reduces the possibility that age is predicted from global size differences rather than anatomical structure. In total, 1261 samples were used with a subject-level train, validation, and test split of [ 868,133,260 ] [868,133,260] . Testing was then performed on both hemispheres to determine whether shadow reduction improves generalisation from the distal to the proximal hemisphere.
blocks.zh: 为了评估回收的结构在近西半球的临床相关性,我们评价了标准年龄预测模型是否可以在减少阴影后更好地利用这一地区。 在[54,55]之后,我们训练了一个3D ResNet-10 [56],以预测胎龄从更可见的异形半球. 该模型接受了第4.1节所述胎儿大脑体积的培训,与共同空间和大小正常一致,从而减少了根据全球体积差异而不是解剖结构预测年龄的可能性。 总共使用了1261个样本,并配属一级列车,验证,试制分型为[868,133,260] [868,133,260]. 然后在两个半球进行测试,以确定减少阴影是否会改善从偏移到近半球的一般化。

blocks.en: 4.6 Evaluation: Consistency of shadow maps
blocks.zh: 4.6 评价: 阴影图的一致性

blocks.en: To evaluate the physical consistency of the predicted shadow maps, and to compare them with the more widely studied shadow confidence maps, we compared our method with Ultra-NeRF [ 22 ] , which addresses a related problem in 2D to 3D ultrasound reconstruction. We first compared the resulting shadow confidence maps visually on fetal brain examples from Meng et al. [57] and on the synthetic liver dataset of Wysocki et al. [22] . We then compared how informative the maps are for a downstream task by using a random forest to segment bone shadows, with the corresponding confidence map provided as an additional input. For a direct comparison, we followed the evaluation setup and, therefore, also the model choice and datasets of Yesilkaynak et al. [58] . Further design details can be found in that work. The random forest was trained either on the simulated ultrasound images alone or on the ultrasound images together with either the Ultra-NeRF confidence maps or our confidence maps. Performance was evaluated numerically and by analysing the feature importance assigned to the shadow maps.
blocks.zh: 为了评价所预测的阴影图的物理一致性,并把它们与被广泛研究的阴影自信图进行比较,我们把我们的方法与Ultra-NERF[22]进行了比较,后者解决了2D到3D超声波重建中的相关问题. 我们首先比较了孟等人在胎儿大脑实例上看到的阴影自信图。 [57] 和关于Wysocki等人的合成肝脏数据集. [22] (中文(简体) ). 然后,我们用一个随机的森林来分块骨影来比较下游任务的地图资料,并提供了相应的信心图作为补充投入。 为了进行直接比较,我们遵循了评价的设置,因此也遵循了Yehilkaynak等人的模式选择和数据集。 [58] (中文(简体) ). 在这项工作中可找到进一步的设计细节。 随机森林要么单独在模拟超声波图像上,要么在超声波图像上与Ultra-NERF信心图或我们的信心图一起接受训练. 对业绩进行了数字评价,并分析了阴影图的特征重要性。

blocks.en:
Visual results for three representative examples from each dataset are shown in Figure 7 , with regions of interest highlighted by orange arrows. This figure also demonstrates shadow reduction on 3D, curvilinear 2D, and linear ultrasound imaging geometries. RFlash effectively reduced shadow artefacts across the evaluated datasets.
In the fetal brain examples, structures in the proximal hemisphere, such as the Sylvian fissure, became more visible where sufficient image information was available for reconstruction.
The contrast between the proximal and distal hemispheres was also more uniform after shadow reduction.
Compared with Hughes shadow reduction, RFlash handled enhancement artefacts more consistently and better equalised contrast across regions with different intensity levels, as highlighted in Figure 7 .

在胎儿脑的例子中,近半球的结构,如西尔维安裂缝,在有足够的图像信息可供重建时,会变得更加明显.
近缘半球和异缘半球的对比度在减少阴影后也更为一致.
如图7所示,与休斯影子减少相比,RFlash处理的增强工艺品在不同强度水平的区域之间更为一致和更加均衡。

As described above, age prediction was trained on size-normalised distal hemispheres and evaluated separately on the distal and proximal hemispheres.
The results are reported in Table 2 . RFlash improved prediction accuracy for both hemispheres, including the distal hemisphere used during training.
The largest benefit was observed in the proximal hemisphere, which was more strongly affected by shadows.
Compared with the original images, RFlash reduced the prediction error in the proximal hemisphere by approximately 5 days relative to no shadow reduction and almost 2 days relative to Hughes shadow reduction, corresponding to relative improvements of 40% and 19%, respectively.

We evaluated the physical plausibility of the predicted shadow confidence maps using established confidence-map baselines.
The visual comparison in Figure 10 suggests that the maps from our physics-informed model produce more realistic shadow segmentations.

Compared with the physics-informed shadow maps from Wysocki et al. [22] , random forests using our shadow maps performed better in all metrics except precision, as shown in Table 3 . Figure 11 shows representative random-forest predictions.

Analysis of SHAP [ 59 ] feature-importance maps further indicates that the maps from RFlash were more informative to the random forest than those from Yesilkaynak et al. [58] , as shown in Figure 12 .

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en:
We presented RFlash , an iterative shadow-reduction method for 2D and 3D ultrasound images.
The method separates shadow reduction into two steps.
First, the input image is decomposed into physics-informed parameter maps using a differentiable ultrasound simulation.
Second, these maps are used to render a shadow-reduced image . RFlash follows the radiance-field view of image formation [ 19 ] , but uses a fully explicit representation instead of an MLP.
This representation is combined with a physics-informed renderer that models the path of beamformed sound through tissue and estimates attenuation and scatter intensity.
After decomposition, shadow-reduced images are rendered by reducing the dependence of each depth on tissue closer to the original transducer position, which can be interpreted as virtually moving the probe through the tissue.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了RFlash,一种二维和三维超声波图像的迭代缩影方法。
该方法将阴影还原分为两个步骤.
首先,输入图像被分解成物理知情参数地图,使用不同的超声模拟.
第二,这些地图用来制作一个减少阴影的图像。 RFlash遵循图像形成的光场视野[19],但使用完全明确的表示而不是MLP.
这种表述与一种物理上知情的渲染器相结合,通过组织模拟束状声音的路径,并估计减弱和散射强度。
分解后,通过降低每个深度对离原转录器位置更近的组织上的依赖性,产生阴影还原图像,这可以解释为几乎将探测器通过组织移动.

blocks.en:
This formulation avoids several limitations of previous shadow-reduction methods.
Classical approaches often rely on strong assumptions about the relation between attenuation and scattering [ 9 ] , while frequency-based techniques require specialised hardware or signal information [ 11 ] .
In contrast, RFlash is applied as a post-processing method and does not depend on vendor-specific scanner access.
This makes it applicable across different ultrasound geometries, including 2D and 3D acquisitions. As it is trained on individual images, there is no knowledge transfer between patients, eliminating the risk of hallucinations.
Evaluation across these different probe geometries and acquisition types supports the robustness of RFlash to variation in the input ultrasound data.
blocks.zh:
这种提法避免了以往减少阴影方法的几个局限性.
古典方法往往依赖于对衰减和散射之间的关系的强烈假设[9],而基于频率的技术则需要专门的硬件或信号信息[11].
相比之下,RFlash作为一种后处理方法应用,并不依赖于供应商专用扫描仪的访问.
这使得它适用于不同的超声波几何,包括2D和3D收购. 由于接受过个人图像培训,患者之间没有知识转移,消除了幻觉的风险.
对这些不同探测器几何和获取类型的评价支持RFlash对输入超声数据变化的稳健性。

blocks.en:
The experiments show that RFlash can reduce shadows visually and quantitatively across different ultrasound image types.
On real data, it outperformed the Hughes shadow-reduction baseline [ 9 ] in the proposed shadow metric and produced more uniform contrast.
In fetal brain ultrasound, the method increased the visibility of structures in the proximal hemisphere, which is typically more affected by acoustic shadows.
The downstream age-prediction experiment further suggests that the recovered information is clinically relevant: for a model trained on the distal hemisphere, shadow reduction improved prediction from the proximal hemisphere compared with both the original images and the baseline.
blocks.zh:
实验显示,RFlash能够从视觉和数量上减少不同超声波图像类型的阴影.
在真实数据上,它的表现超过了拟议的阴影度量中休斯影子减排基线[9],并产生了更统一的对比.
在胎儿大脑超声波中,这种方法提高了近西半球结构的能见度,通常受声波阴影的影响更大.
下游的年龄预测实验进一步表明,所回收的信息在临床上是相关的:对于一个接受过异形半球训练的模型来说,与原始图像和基线相比,减少阴影从近色半球改进了预测。

blocks.en:
We also evaluated the physical consistency of the derived shadow confidence maps.
Because these maps are computed directly from the attenuation-related decomposition, they provide an interpretable estimate of shadow formation.
Compared with related confidence maps from Wysocki et al. [22] , our maps produced visually and quantitatively stronger guidance for random-forest shadow segmentation.
The SHAP analysis further indicated that the random forest assigned more importance to our shadow maps, suggesting that they contain more task-relevant shadow information.
blocks.zh:
我们还评估了衍生出的阴影信任图的物理一致性。
由于这些地图是直接从衰减相关的分解中计算出来的,它们提供了对阴影形成可解释的估计.
与Wysocki等人的相关信任地图相比. [22] 我们的地图为随机森林阴影分割绘制了视觉和数量上更强的指南。
SHAP分析进一步表明,随机森林更重视我们的影子地图,认为它们包含更多与任务相关的影子信息.

blocks.en:
As the method is trained on an individual-image basis, it can only recover structures that are still present in the image.
Although this allows for more post-processing, it limits the structures that can be recovered.
Applying the method to channel or RF data, which contain more information, may increase its clinical relevance, but reduce its applicability scanners which allow for RF data access.
Further it relies on accurate geometry estimation. Quite often, the scanner geometry can be found in the scanners spec sheets. If this is not the case, geometry estimation is needed with is a non-trivial task, as seen for the abdominal dataset.
As an iterative method, RFlash is slower than closed-form solutions. Our code has not been optimised for speed, and runtime might be shortened with a hardware-optimised implementation.
blocks.zh:
由于该方法是在个人形象的基础上训练的,它只能恢复图像中仍然存在的结构.
虽然这允许更多的后处理,但限制了可以回收的结构.
应用该方法来引导含有更多信息的RF数据或RF数据,可能增加其临床相关性,但降低其可应用性扫描仪,从而允许RF数据访问.
此外,它还依赖于准确的几何估计。 扫描仪几何往往可以在扫描仪的光谱表中找到. 如果情况并非如此,则需要进行几何估计是一项非三角任务,腹部数据集就是如此。
作为一种迭代方法,RFlash比闭式解决方案慢. 我们的代码还没有对速度进行优化,运行时间可能会随着硬件优化的实施而缩短.
